SourceText: Co-op against the AI behind tough walls. Enemy AIs take turns sending siege waves that grow every time, while your units and defenses are far sturdier. Every value is set in the lobby, next to all the standard game options.
TranslatedText: 和朋友一起守城打 AI。敌方 AI 轮流派出攻城波次，一波比一波猛；你的单位和防御建筑则耐打得多。所有数值都在房间设置里调整，标准模式的选项全部保留。

SourceText: Health multiplier for human players' military units.
TranslatedText: 真人玩家军事单位的血量倍率。

SourceText: Health multiplier for human players' walls, gates, towers, outposts and keeps.
TranslatedText: 真人玩家城墙、城门、哨塔和城堡的血量倍率。
哪些玩家不能建造巨型投石机。

SourceText: Unit production speed multiplier for AI players' buildings.
TranslatedText: AI 玩家建筑的单位生产速度倍率。

SourceText: Multiplies how much every gold and stone deposit on the map holds.
TranslatedText: 地图上所有金矿和石矿的储量倍率。
所有玩家（含 AI）开局时的村民数量。

SourceText: Humans win if they are still alive after this long.
TranslatedText: 坚持到这个时间，真人一方获胜。

SourceText: Units in each attack wave. One AI attacks at a time, spawning near its town center.
TranslatedText: 每波攻城的单位数量。AI 轮流出兵，从自己的城镇中心附近出发。

SourceText: When the first attack wave starts.
TranslatedText: 第一波攻城开始的时间。
